authprobe.title: AuthProbe
authprobe.server.add.tip: Add a server with its own nicks and passwords
authprobe.chat.logsOnly.tip: Show only [AuthProbe] lines in the pane. Available while debug logs are on
authprobe.button.import.tip: Import nicks and passwords from .txt (replaces current profiles)
authprobe.import.title: AuthProbe — import nicks and passwords
authprobe.import.hint: Format: nick | comment, then passwords one per line; blank lines are ignored
authprobe.import.none: No nicknames found in the file
authprobe.import.dialogFailed: Could not open the file dialog: %s
authprobe.option.mode.tip: Which login command to send: /l or /login
authprobe.option.smartdelay.tip: The server sets the pace: a "wait N s" line is honored, the same password is re-sent and the try is not spent. The Delay button is inactive while this is on
authprobe.option.delay.tip: Pause between sends so the server does not treat them as flood
authprobe.option.reconnect.tip: Delay before reconnecting automatically after a kick
authprobe.option.autostart.tip: Start probing as soon as the server connection is up
authprobe.option.autoreconnect.tip: Reconnect after a kick; on IP ban, VPN/proxy filter or timeout, change proxy first
authprobe.option.debug.tip: Print the password of every attempt to chat in yellow (local only); the same lines are mirrored into the Server chat pane
authprobe.option.mod.tip: Disable chat capture, command interception and probing for normal play
authprobe.option.macro.tip: Allow the keybind to run .start/.go. Bind it in Options → Controls → AuthProbe
authprobe.button.start.tip: Save settings, swap the session and connect
authprobe.button.stop.tip: Stop the run and print the position
authprobe.button.patterns.tip: Server message patterns and kick reasons
authprobe.button.menu.tip: Save and return to the title screen
authprobe.patterns.title: Message patterns
authprobe.patterns.nickkicks.desc: Nick busy or invalid → skip the nickname
authprobe.patterns.proxykicks.desc: IP ban, VPN/proxy, timeout → change proxy
authprobe.status.title: AuthProbe - disconnected
authprobe.status.run: Nicks done: %s · started at #%s · interrupted at #%s of %s
authprobe.status.run.done: Nicks done: %s · started at #%s · finished at #%s of %s
authprobe.nick.add.tip: Add a nickname with its own password list
authprobe.nick.clear.tip: Delete all profiles of this server
authprobe.nick.skip.clear.tip: Clear the skip mark of this nickname
authprobe.option.proxy.tip: Route the connection through a proxy from the list
authprobe.option.proxy.settings.tip: Open the proxy list and checker
authprobe.proxy.title: Proxy
authprobe.proxy.needAddress: set a valid server address first
